name: smart-resume
description: /smart-resume <what you remember>: Haiku finds the 1-3 past sessions that match, shows what was done in each, and resumes the one you pick.

model.title: Search model
model.description: Model that picks and summarizes sessions (an alias such as haiku, or a full model id).

maxResults.title: Max suggestions
maxResults.description: How many sessions to suggest at most (1-3).

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the dialog and the summaries. auto follows the search text, then $LANG.
